Event Description: A fight has broken out between the prisoners. What do you do?
Lightning struck the camp and something is burning.
Prisoners are pumped up and want to show who's boss.
The raiders captured some prisoners. They want a ransom.
Prisoners wounded in the attack fall sick.
Raid left the camp in ruins and prisoners are trapped under the rubble.
Raiders set the warehouse on fire. Prisoners can attempt to save it.
Fending off the raid made prisoners eager to work.
